literal: In enmity excelling is sweet, he who says, life declining and perishing is near.
translation: The life of a man who says it is sweet to excel in enmity is close to decline and ruin.
modern: பகைமையில் வெற்றி பெறுவது இனிமையானது என்று சொல்லும் ஒருவனது வாழ்க்கை, விரைவில் குறைந்து அழிந்து போவதற்கு அருகில் உள்ளது.
explanation: This couplet warns against finding pleasure in conflict and hostility. The phrase 'இகலின் மிகல் இனிது' captures the dangerous mindset of someone who enjoys overpowering others through enmity. The words 'தவலும்' (declining) and 'கெடலும்' (perishing) show the inevitable two-stage downfall of such a person. Ultimately, the poet states that ruin is 'நணித்து' (near) for anyone who makes a lifestyle out of hostility.
